coordinates.note: The coordinates are quoted to a fraction of an arcsecond (22 deg 57 min 29.0 sec S, 67 deg 47 min 10.4 sec W), but only in a physics paper (arXiv, rank 10), which A17 does not accept as the sole basis of a `detector` point, so the point is recorded as campus-grade/approximate. The companion POLARBEAR B-mode paper (arXiv:1403.2369) gives 29.03 sec for the latitude.

name: James Ax Observatory, Cerro Toco (POLARBEAR / Simons Array)

place.region: Antofagasta Region (Cerro Toco, near San Pedro de Atacama)

summary.plain: The small observatory on Cerro Toco, in northern Chile, that holds the 2.5-metre Huan Tran Telescope of the POLARBEAR experiment and, later, the Simons Array telescopes.
summary.technical: James Ax Observatory on Cerro Toco at 5200 m in the Parque Astronómico Atacama: Huan Tran Telescope (POLARBEAR-1, first light 10 January 2012) and the Simons Array (POLARBEAR-2 receivers).
